description: Which error spellings may a typed cell carry literally? A one-cell package <c r="A1" t="e"><v>CODE</v></c> was written for each code and opened interactively. Separately, Excel computed a #SPILL! (=SEQUENCE(3) over a blocking value), a #CALC! (a FILTER matching nothing) and a #DIV/0! over COM and saved the workbook, and read #BUSY! back from its one-cell package through Range.Text and Value2.
probe: .claude/skills/excel-gui-automation/scripts/open-verdict.ps1 per package; a one-off COM script for the computed errors

excelSaved.=SEQUENCE(3) spilling into a value: <c r="A1" t="e" cm="1" vm="1"><f t="array" aca="1" ref="A1" ca="1">_xlfn.SEQUENCE(3)</f><v>#VALUE!</v></c>, valueMetadata naming a rich value of structure _error with errorType 8
excelSaved.=FILTER(D1:D3,D1:D3>100): <c r="C1" t="e" cm="1" vm="2"><f t="array" ref="C1">_xlfn._xlws.FILTER(D1:D3,D1:D3>100)</f><v>#VALUE!</v></c>, a rich value of structure _error with errorType 13
